meaning: Retorsion, formally and from no premises: the denial of an instance of excluded middle commits its holder to ¬p and ¬¬p (denyingExcludedMiddleInstanceSelfContradictory, also verified), so no instance can be consistently denied. Refutes the denial alternative STMT-SOME-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-INSTANCE-FAILS. It does not refute withholding assent (intuitionism, STMT-EXCLUDED-MIDDLE-WITHHELD-INTUITIONISM) and does not prove excluded middle.
